display.title: Mowzie's Mobs: The Sculptor
display.subtitle: Outlast the stone shaper
description: Atop a remote peak waits the §8Sculptor§r, an ancient being who tests
challengers across a gauntlet of stone trials before the duel itself. Pass his
trials, then defeat him to claim mastery of the peak.
§7The most demanding of the Tier 1 overworld bosses — patience and footwork win.
